decision.explanation: Both answers are valid and refer to distinct phases of the same entity. From D1S3, the original main use of Los Angeles’ Strategic Extraction and Restoration zones (SERZ) was to identify and target high-crime areas with a focus on precrime. From D2S2, the zones were later repurposed as art galleries after the discontinuation of the policing software in 2020. These are complementary uses of the same physical locations over time, not conflicting claims.
